recentItems.title: How discarded oyster shells get a second life
recentItems.description: Discarded oyster shells can be reused instead of thrown away, giving them a second life in coastal restoration projects.

recentItems.title: Why are so many men carrying purses?
recentItems.description: Jacob Elordi, Erling Haaland and A$AP Rocky are among the stars making handbags part of their everyday style. So, is the “purse guy” having a moment — or is this trend here to stay?

recentItems.title: Trump says Iran conflict is 'small potatoes for us'
recentItems.description:
President Donald Trump on Friday said the conflict in Iran is “small potatoes” as he defended Vice President JD Vance for asserting that months of on-and-off attacks in the Middle East are not a “war.”
